initial_risks: Root geometry must fit usable soil polygons; foliage extents do not represent roots.
Trailing arch must clear coping and remain rearward of sitting ribbon and frontal approach.
Supported retaining cell change must maintain the original seat profile and 2mm seam.
Native mesh witnesses must validate physical markers; geometry datums and use directions are not physical surfaces.
Whole-asset collision envelopes must not consume the underseat, soil access, approach or useful outlook gaps.
Layered planting must read as intentional distinct cluster forms at ordinary heights rather than one dense wall.
acceptance_scope: Original editable component quality only; no host, engine, species, wind, loads, or measured runtime performance.
